title: A parsed Box SSE frame
description:
The frame src/box/engine.ts writeFrame() emits: on the wire it is the text `event: <name>
data: <JSON>

`. This schema describes the frame PARSED into { event, data }: `event` is the event name, `data` is the JSON-parsed payload. Obtained by building a REAL frame string via the same writeFrame formatting the engine uses over a real snapshot() payload, then parsing it back. A 'snapshot' frame's data must additionally satisfy box-sse-snapshot.schema.json (asserted separately in the suite). The envelope is CLOSED; data is left OPEN here because the payload varies by event name and is validated per-event.

data.$comment: OPEN by design: the payload shape depends on the event name; the snapshot payload is validated by box-sse-snapshot.schema.json.
